general.name: Windows - Factory Reset [Win]
general.description:
Starts Reset this PC remotely after safety checks; the device reboots, is erased and drops out of Datto RMM. Needs the serial number and ticket typed in.
Source: https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components/tree/main/Scripts/windows-factory-reset-win

variables.name: usrConfirm
variables.description: No = run the safety checks only and change nothing. ERASE = reset the device if every check passes.

variables.name: usrConfirmSerial
variables.description: The serial number of the device to erase, as shown on its Datto or Autotask record. The job refuses if it does not match the device it runs on.

variables.name: usrTicketNumber
variables.description: The Autotask ticket authorising the reset, like T20261028.0001. Required.

variables.name: usrResetMode
variables.description: RemoveEverything = Reset this PC > Remove everything. KeepMyFiles = Keep my files. Protected = cannot be interrupted, cleans partitions on failure, may leave the device unbootable (lost/stolen only).

variables.name: usrBitLockerKeySaved
variables.description: Yes = the BitLocker recovery key for this device is escrowed. Required when BitLocker is on; the job prints the key ID to match.

variables.name: usrIgnoreBattery
variables.description: true = proceed even if the device is running on battery.
